comparison: one blinded view per case, not order-swapped
note: Sphere comparison uncertain because SFT produced no canvas. Retained separately as an execution failure. These are evaluation opinions, not training rewards.

cases.reason: A presents a clearer, more coherent cube with convincing planar structure, readable pink top and gray side, and a grounded shadow; B is softer and more atmospheric but its top plane and edges are less defined and the form feels less stable.
weaknesses_A: The cube is taller and more sharply outlined than the squat reference, and the shadow is very faint and broad.
weaknesses_B: The cube's upper edges and right face are washed out, weakening its geometric structure and dimensional clarity.

cases.reason: B cleanly depicts a complete translucent golden cylinder with a readable elliptical rim, opening, base, and soft shadow; A is visibly cropped at the upper-left edge and does not provide a judgeable full canvas.
weaknesses_A: The canvas is dominated by an off-frame partial cylinder in the upper-left, so the object is incomplete and compositionally unusable.
weaknesses_B: The cylinder has somewhat hard, dark contour lines and flatter vertical shading than the soft watercolor reference.

cases.reason: A is the more successful cup interpretation: the vessel, opening, golden body, handle, and grounding shadow are all recognizable and coherently related; B loses the cup silhouette and turns the handle into a detached angular yellow shape.
weaknesses_A: The cup is much smaller and more vertically rigid than the reference, with a thin outlined body and a handle that reads as a flat ring.
weaknesses_B: The handle is disconnected and angular, the cup body is reduced to a pale rectangular slab, and the overall silhouette no longer reads clearly as the reference mug.

cases.reason: A gives a complete, readable watercolor bus with a coherent long body, wheels, windows, and slanted front; B is closer in some window placement but is severely zoomed and clipped at both sides, weakening the composition.
weaknesses_A: The bus has fewer and fainter windows than the reference, and its front slope is exaggerated.
weaknesses_B: The image is cropped at the left and right edges, while the enlarged translucent body loses the reference's complete bus silhouette.

cases.reason: B preserves the reference flower's six-petal spread, translucent layered petals, yellow center, stem, and green leaf with a lively balanced composition; A is much smaller and collapses the flower into a compact circular cluster.
weaknesses_A: The petals are compressed into a round disk, reducing the open six-petal structure, and the leaf is a disconnected angular triangle.
weaknesses_B: The green leaf is more triangular and detached than the reference, and the layered center is darker and more crowded.

cases.reason: A is a convincing house interpretation with a readable green facade, two openings, red roof, pale side plane, and grounding shadow; B has a pleasing simple roof but loses the side volume and much of the house's structural clarity.
weaknesses_A: The roof and front facade are slightly oversized and the small window is faint, while the house sits lower and flatter than the reference.
weaknesses_B: The side wall is nearly absent, the roof is asymmetrically simplified, and the dark door-like mark dominates the otherwise vague facade.

cases.reason: A preserves more of the reference's three stacked wave bands and their horizontal rhythm; B leaves the subject almost entirely outside the frame, with only two cropped arcs at the lower right.
weaknesses_A: The composition is severely cropped and displaced to the lower-right, so the three-wave arrangement is only partially visible.
The pale field and faint diagonal marks compete with the already low-contrast wave forms.
weaknesses_B: Nearly all of the wave subject is absent from the canvas, leaving only two partial arcs at the lower-right edge.
The large empty field provides little visual structure or connection to the reference's centered stacked rhythm.

cases.reason: B is the more legible and composed sailboat interpretation: its hull, mast, pale left sail, and warm right sail read cleanly together, while A's mast and sail geometry are weaker and its hull feels heavier and less integrated.
weaknesses_A: The left sail is effectively missing and the mast ends in an awkward bent tip, weakening the boat's identity.
The broad dark hull and jagged upper edge dominate the delicate sails, producing an imbalanced silhouette.
weaknesses_B: The left sail remains extremely faint and underdefined compared with the reference.
Thin colored horizontal marks beneath the hull are distracting and read as stray artifacts rather than water.

cases.reason: A more cleanly captures the reference's quiet cylinder-and-sphere still life, with a coherent pale shadow and uncluttered edges; B adds conspicuous blue tick-like marks around the cylinder that break the softness and distract from the objects.
weaknesses_A: The cylinder is paler and less volumetric than the reference, and its vertical contour is somewhat washed out.
The ground shadow is very faint, so the objects feel lightly anchored.
weaknesses_B: Blue tick-like marks around both cylinder sides are visibly distracting and inconsistent with the reference's soft painted edges.
The stronger dark sphere and long shadow pull attention away from the cylinder and make the balance feel heavier than the reference.

cases.reason: The missing A image prevents full pairwise visual comparison; the available B canvas can be critiqued but cannot establish a winner against an unseen candidate.
weaknesses_B: The blue form is a fragmented, translucent cluster rather than the reference's single rounded sphere, with a prominent diagonal line across the lower half.

cases.reason: A has a broader, more balanced pink canopy and a clear trunk that better preserve the reference tree's overall spread and grounding; B is softer but its canopy is more vertically stacked and the trunk is oversized.
weaknesses_A: The thin black branch lines are visually harsh and the trunk is more rectangular and isolated than in the reference.
weaknesses_B: The canopy collapses toward the center, the trunk is disproportionately wide, and the faint shadow gives the tree less grounding.

cases.reason: A more successfully captures the reference vase's tall neck, narrow shoulder, blue translucent body, and visible opening; B has a broad appealing body but loses the slender neck and reads as a squat vessel.
weaknesses_A: The vase is much smaller in frame and its body is overly symmetrical, with a very faint grounding shadow.
weaknesses_B: The neck is nearly absent, the body is too wide and squat, and the right side facet is exaggerated into a blocky protrusion.
